start.text: The invitation slipped under your door simply read: 'Midnight. The old clocktower. Come alone.' You stand shivering in the rain, the rusted iron door looming before you.

choices.choice_text: Push the heavy iron door open.
Walk around the back to look for a window.

inside_tower.text: The door creaks shut behind you, plunging you into darkness. A single candle flickers on a dusty table in the center of the room, illuminating a small wooden box.

choices.choice_text: Leave the box and search the shadows along the wall.

alleyway.text: The alley is pitch black. You trip over something metallic that clatters loudly against the cobblestones. Suddenly, a flashlight beam hits your face.

choices.choice_text: Run back to the main street.
Shield your eyes and demand to know who is there.

box_opened.text: You lift the lid. Inside rests a silver key wrapped in a note that reads: 'You passed the first test. Use this on the trapdoor beneath the rug.'

choices.choice_text: Examine the heavy rug on the floor.

trapdoor_room.text: You pull back the dusty rug to reveal a heavy wooden trapdoor with a silver-rimmed keyhole.

choices.choice_text: Leave it and head out to the back alleyway instead.

secret_basement.text: The trapdoor creaks open, revealing a stone ladder leading down into a glowing secret archives room. You have uncovered the truth of the clocktower!

shadows.text: As you feel along the damp stone wall, your hand presses a hidden brick. A mechanism grinds to life, and a hidden door swings open into a brightly lit study.

game_over_run.text: You panic and bolt back out to the street. You look back, but the silhouette tracking you has disappeared into the rain. You missed your chance to find the truth.

confrontation.text: The flashlight lowers. A figure steps forward, holding a matching invitation. 'Good,' a familiar voice says. 'I was hoping you would show up.'
